description: Returns the number of possible tracing result by executing an eth call within the context of the given block execution.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The transaction call object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: from
sub_parameters.description: The address the transaction is sent from

sub_parameters.name: to
sub_parameters.description: The address the transaction is directed to

sub_parameters.name: gas
sub_parameters.description: The integer of the gas provided for the transaction execution

sub_parameters.name: gasPrice
sub_parameters.description: The integer of the gasPrice used for each paid gas

sub_parameters.name: value
sub_parameters.description: The integer of the value sent with this transaction

sub_parameters.name: data
sub_parameters.description: The hash of the method signature and encoded parameters

parameters.name: blockReference
parameters.description: The block number in hexadecimal format, the block hash, or tags. The supported tag values include earliest for the earliest/genesis block, latest for the latest mined block, pending for the pending state/transactions, safe for the most recent secure block, and finalized for the most recent secure block accepted by more than 2/3 of validators. safe and finalized are only supported on Ethereum, Gnosis, Arbitrum, Arbitrum Nova, and Avalanche C-chain

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The tracer object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: tracer
sub_parameters.description: The type of tracer. It could be callTracer or prestateTracer

sub_parameters.name: callTracer
sub_parameters.description: The calltracer keeps track of all call frames, including depth 0 calls, that are made during a transaction

sub_parameters.name: prestateTracer
sub_parameters.description: The prestateTracer replays the transaction and tracks every part of state that occured during the transaction

sub_parameters.name: tracerConfig
sub_parameters.description: The object to specify the configurations of the tracer

sub_parameters.name: onlyTopCall
sub_parameters.description: When set to true, this will only trace the primary (top-level) call and not any sub-calls. It eliminates the additional processing for each call frame

sub_parameters.name: diffMode
sub_parameters.description: When set to true, diff mode returns the differences between the transaction's pre and post-state. The result object will contain a pre and a post object.

result.description: The transaction trace object, which has the following fields:

result.failed.description: The transaction is successful or not

result.gas.description: The total consumed gas in the transaction

result.returnValue.description: The return value of the executed contract call

result.structLogs.description: The trace result of each step with the following fields:

result.structLogs.op.description: The name of current executing operation

result.structLogs.gas.description: The available gas in the execution

result.structLogs.gasCost.description: The gas cost of the operation

result.structLogs.depth.description: The number of levels of calling functions

result.structLogs.stack.description: An array of values in the current stack

result.structLogs.memory.description: An array of values in the current memory

result.structLogs.storage.description: The mapping of the current storage

result.structLogs.refund.description: The total of current refund value
